items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I wasn’t like, you know Jack DeJohnette or, you know, Tony Williams ‘cause they were all — I think that, I remember first teaching in the College of William Paterson and I asked somebody who their favorite older drummer was and they said Tony Williams.

ctx.x: Well your students probably would do the same thing with you.

Most of them are too young to even know my oeuvre so to speak, or you know they knew about me and I was on the faculty of a jazz school so I was certainly well known but I wasn’t like, you know Jack DeJohnette or, you know, Tony Williams ‘cause they were all — I think that, I remember first teaching in the College of William Paterson and I asked somebody who their favorite older drummer was and they said Tony Williams.
